title: Latent Fault Hunter and Pager Escalation Matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: The current SLO alerting stack produces noisy burn-rate alerts and brittle paging decisions during transient microbursts. We lack a lightweight, per-service scoring layer that combines tracing hooks, fast metrics/log enrichment, and anomaly fingerprints to decide whether a burn-rate event should page, escalate, or auto-resolve.

Goal: Build a small-footprint 'Latent Fault Hunter' service + pager escalation matrix that: 1) enriches burn-rate alerts with trace-derived root-cause signatures and recent deploy/rollout metadata, 2) runs fast anomaly fingerprinting on metric windows to suppress non-actionable noise, and 3) outputs a single graded pager decision (noisy/suppress/route-to-platform/escalate). The system should integrate with existing trace hooks and metrics/log ingestion pipelines and ship a dashboard for SREs and product SLIs to inspect decisions.

Scope: tracing hook adapters, an enrichment pipeline (k8s metadata, rollout tags, config snapshot), anomaly fingerprint model (lightweight histogram clustering), decision matrix service, and a read-only latency/error dashboard. Not in scope: full ML model training pipeline (we will use an offline model and fast feature extractor).
acceptance_criteria: Burn-rate alerts in a sample of 8 services are enriched with trace signatures and rollout metadata within 60s of alert creation
False-positive paging rate reduced by >= 40% for the pilot cohort compared to baseline month
Pager decision API returns a graded decision and rationale fields and is documented in the runbook
Dashboard shows alert -> trace -> fingerprint chain within 90s and is accessible to SRE/PM/Product
End-to-end latency for enrichment path (alert -> decision) stays under 120s under normal load
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 wks): Design spec + trace hook adapter prototype. Define minimal trace attributes needed (span error flags, top-3 span names, sample stack). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latent+Fault+Hunter+Spec

Phase 2 (3 wks): Build enrichment pipeline that consumes burn-rate alerts from AlertRouter, queries trace-store for recent correlated traces, merges k8s/deploy metadata, and emits a fingerprint vector to the decision service
Phase 3 (2 wks): Implement lightweight fingerprinting (histogram clustering + L2 distance threshold) and an initial decision matrix with tunable thresholds exposed via feature flags
Phase 4 (2 wks): Dashboard and runbook, pilot rollout to service cohort (auth, RBAC), and collect metrics on paging reductions
Phase 5 (ongoing): Iterate thresholds, extend to more services, and consider ML-augmented scoring in future cycles
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Trace lookup latency may blow up enrichment SLO. Mitigation: limit search window to 2 minutes, use precomputed trace indices for hot services, and fall back to metric-only decision if trace lookup times out

Risk: Decision matrix suppresses an actionable outage. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds for initial pilot, explicit 'force-page' override from AlertRouter, and audit logs for every suppressed decision
Risk: Oncall confusion about new graded decisions. Mitigation: add clear rationale fields, show top-3 contributing signals on dashboard, and run a training session with oncall one week before pilot
observability_changes: New trace hook fields required: span_error_count, top_spans (list), replica_id, rollout_tag
Metrics pipeline change: add a 10s resolution rolling histogram for p95/p99 latencies to the short-term metrics tier
Logging: add structured alert enrichment logs to the observability ingestion topic with correlation_id
notes: PM review (2025-02-20): Marisol requested explicit rollout tags from deployment pipeline; engineering to add a minimal webhook to attach rollout metadata
SRE feedback (2025-02-25): prefer a 3-tier pager decision (suppress / page-team / page-platform) rather than binary; updated decision matrix accordingly
Security review: scoped to read-only trace queries and enrichment; no PII access. Security to re-evaluate for extended pilot
